  const o = new THREE.LineSegments(g, segMat(op));
  o.renderOrder = order || 2;
  scene.add(o);
  return o;
}
function rect(cx, cy, w, h){ const x0 = cx - w / 2, x1 = cx + w / 2, y0 = cy - h / 2, y1 = cy + h / 2; return [x0,y0,0,x1,y0,0, x1,y0,0,x1,y1,0, x1,y1,0,x0,y1,0, x0,y1,0,x0,y0,0]; }
function dashedRect(cx, cy, w, h, dash){
  const out = [], x0 = cx - w / 2, y0 = cy - h / 2, pts = [[x0,y0],[x0+w,y0],[x0+w,y0+h],[x0,y0+h],[x0,y0]];
  for (let s = 0; s < 4; s++) {
    const [ax, ay] = pts[s], [bx, by] = pts[s + 1], len = Math.hypot(bx - ax, by - ay), n = Math.floor(len / (dash * 2));
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const t0 = (k * 2 * dash) / len, t1 = Math.min(1, (k * 2 + 1) * dash / len); out.push(ax + (bx - ax) * t0, ay + (by - ay) * t0, 0, ax + (bx - ax) * t1, ay + (by - ay) * t1, 0); }
  }
  return out;
}

const wikiDoc = segObject([
  ...rect(W.x, W.y, 0.3, 0.38),
  W.x - 0.1, W.y + 0.1, 0, W.x + 0.1, W.y + 0.1, 0,
  W.x - 0.1, W.y + 0.02, 0, W.x + 0.1, W.y + 0.02, 0,
  W.x - 0.1, W.y - 0.06, 0, W.x + 0.04, W.y - 0.06, 0
], COL.ink, 1, 1, 4);
const apiBox = segObject([
  ...rect(A.x, A.y, 0.3, 0.3),
  A.x - 0.15, A.y + 0.05, 0, A.x + 0.15, A.y + 0.05, 0,
  A.x - 0.15, A.y - 0.05, 0, A.x + 0.15, A.y - 0.05, 0
], COL.ink, 1, 0, 4);
const qBox = segObject(dashedRect(Q.x, Q.y, Q.w + 0.12, Q.h + 0.12, 0.035), COL.red, 1, 0, 4);
const barrier = segObject([
  BX, W.y - 0.3, 0, BX, W.y + 0.3, 0,
  BX - 0.04, W.y - 0.3, 0, BX + 0.04, W.y - 0.3, 0,
  BX - 0.04, W.y + 0.3, 0, BX + 0.04, W.y + 0.3, 0
], COL.ink, 1, 0, 4);

/* the published edit log: every write, at once */
const logCoords = [];
for (let k = 0; k < 1500; k++) {
  const i = Math.floor(rnd() * N);
  logCoords.push(base[i * 3], base[i * 3 + 1], base[i * 3 + 2], W.x - 0.13 + rnd() * 0.08, W.y + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0);
}
const logLines = segObject(logCoords, COL.ink, 0.075, 0, 1);

/* live writes */
const POOL = 300;
const lPos = new Float32Array(POOL * 6), lCol = new Float32Array(POOL * 8);
const lGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
lGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(lPos, 3).setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage));
lGeo.setAttribute('aColor', new THREE.BufferAttribute(lCol, 4).setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage));
const live = new THREE.LineSegments(lGeo, segMat(1));
live.renderOrder = 2;
scene.add(live);
const L = Array.from({ length: POOL }, () => ({ on: false, s: [0,0,0], e: [0,0,0], b: 0, d: 1, c: COL.ink, a: 0 }));
let lNext = 0;

function ringMesh(p){ const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.036, 0.05, 32), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: COL.ink, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthTest: false })); m.position.copy(p); m.renderOrder = 4; scene.add(m); return m; }
const modRing = ringMesh(MOD), opRing = ringMesh(OP);

const band = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.3, 3.9), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: COL.mark, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthTest: false, depthWrite: false }));
band.renderOrder = 0;
scene.add(band);

/* labels */
const labels = {};
stage.querySelectorAll('.slabel').forEach(el => { labels[el.dataset.l] = el; });
const LPOS = {
  W: new THREE.Vector3(W.x, W.y + 0.26, 0), A: new THREE.Vector3(A.x, A.y + 0.22, 0),
  Q: new THREE.Vector3(Q.x, Q.y - Q.h / 2 - 0.08, 0), B: new THREE.Vector3(BX, W.y - 0.33, 0),
  M: new THREE.Vector3(MOD.x, MOD.y + 0.09, 0), O: new THREE.Vector3(OP.x, OP.y + 0.09, 0)
};
labels.Q.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, 0)';
labels.B.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, 0)';

/* story steps, indexed like the data-step attributes */
const DEF = { mode: 'wiki', rate: 0, log: 0, mod: 0, op: 0, fleet: 0, dim: 1, scan: 'none', catch: 0, quar: 0, confirm: 0, barrier: 0 };
const STEPS = [
  { rate: 0.35 },
  { rate: 0.45 },
  { rate: 0.1 },
  { rate: 0.4, mod: 1 },
  { rate: 1, mod: 1 },
  { rate: 0.75, mod: 1, op: 1 },
  { rate: 0.02, mod: 1, op: 1 },
  { rate: 0, log: 1, mod: 1, op: 1 },
  { rate: 0, log: 1, mod: 1, op: 1, dim: 0.7 },
  { rate: 0.3, log: 0.35, dim: 0.85 },
  { mode: 'watch', rate: 0.55, fleet: 1, scan: 'loop' },
  { mode: 'catch', rate: 0.55, fleet: 1, scan: 'sweep', catch: 1 },
  { mode: 'stop', rate: 0.5, fleet: 1, catch: 1, quar: 1 },
  { mode: 'fix', rate: 0.55, fleet: 1, catch: 1, confirm: 1, barrier: 1 }
].map(s => Object.assign({}, DEF, s));

const cur = { log: 0, mod: 0, op: 0, fleet: 0, dim: 1, catch: 0, quar: 0, confirm: 0, barrier: 0, band: 0, fleetLbl: 0 };
let stepIdx = Math.min(window.__brStep || 0, STEPS.length - 1);
let S = STEPS[stepIdx];
let stepT0 = 0, clock = 0, acc = 0;

function agentPos(i, t, out){
  const s = seed[i];
  const dx = Math.sin(t * 0.35 + s * 6.2832) * 0.035, dy = Math.cos(t * 0.29 + s * 12.0) * 0.035, dz = Math.sin(t * 0.21 + s * 3.0) * 0.035;
  let x = base[i * 3] + dx, y = base[i * 3 + 1] + dy, z = base[i * 3 + 2] + dz;
  const q = bad[i] * cur.fleet * cur.quar;
  if (q > 0) { x += (qpos[i * 3] + dx * 0.3 - x) * q; y += (qpos[i * 3 + 1] + dy * 0.3 - y) * q; z += (qpos[i * 3 + 2] + dz * 0.3 - z) * q; }
  out[0] = x; out[1] = y; out[2] = z;
}
const pick = arr => arr[Math.floor(rnd() * arr.length)];
function spawn(t){
  const l = L[lNext]; lNext = (lNext + 1) % POOL;
  let i, dest, c = COL.ink, a = 0.34;
  const toW = () => [W.x - 0.13 + rnd() * 0.06, W.y + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0];
  const toA = () => [A.x - 0.13 + rnd() * 0.06, A.y + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.24, 0];
  if (S.mode === 'wiki') { i = Math.floor(rnd() * N); dest = toW(); }
  else if (S.mode === 'stop') { i = pick(goodIdx); dest = toA(); a = 0.24; }
  else if (rnd() < 0.32) {
    i = pick(badIdx);
    if (S.mode === 'fix') { dest = [BX - 0.012, W.y + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.5, 0]; c = COL.graphite; a = 0.6; }
    else { dest = toW(); a = 0.45; if (S.mode === 'catch' && base[i * 3] < U.uScanX.value) { c = COL.red; a = 0.85; } }
  } else { i = pick(goodIdx); dest = toA(); a = 0.24; }
  agentPos(i, t, l.s);
  l.e = dest; l.c = c; l.a = a; l.b = t; l.d = 0.9 + rnd() * 0.7; l.on = true;
}
function updateLines(t){
  for (let k = 0; k < POOL; k++) {
    const l = L[k], p = k * 6, q = k * 8;
    let age = reduce ? 0.5 : (t - l.b) / l.d;
    if (!l.on || age >= 1) { l.on = false; lCol[q + 3] = 0; lCol[q + 7] = 0; lPos.fill(0, p, p + 6); continue; }
    const g = Math.min(1, age * 2.4), e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - g, 3);
    const alpha = l.a * (age < 0.5 ? 1 : 1 - (age - 0.5) / 0.5);
    lPos[p] = l.s[0]; lPos[p + 1] = l.s[1]; lPos[p + 2] = l.s[2];
    lPos[p + 3] = l.s[0] + (l.e[0] - l.s[0]) * e; lPos[p + 4] = l.s[1] + (l.e[1] - l.s[1]) * e; lPos[p + 5] = l.s[2] + (l.e[2] - l.s[2]) * e;
    lCol[q] = lCol[q + 4] = l.c.r; lCol[q + 1] = lCol[q + 5] = l.c.g; lCol[q + 2] = lCol[q + 6] = l.c.b;
    lCol[q + 3] = alpha * 0.55; lCol[q + 7] = alpha;
  }
  lGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
  lGeo.attributes.aColor.needsUpdate = true;
}

let vw = 1, vh = 1;
function resize(){
  const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
  vw = Math.max(1, r.width); vh = Math.max(1, r.height);
  renderer.setSize(vw, vh, false);
  camera.aspect = vw / vh;
  const half = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov / 2));
  const narrow = vw < 560;
  const fitW = narrow ? 5.0 : 5.1, fitH = narrow ? 3.3 : 3.7;
  const dist = Math.max((fitH / 2) / half, (fitW / 2) / (half * camera.aspect));
  camera.position.set(0, CENTER.y, dist);
  camera.lookAt(CENTER);
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  U.uDist.value = dist;
  U.uPix.value = renderer.getPixelRatio();
  U.uSize.value = Math.max(1.6, Math.min(2.6, vw / 300));
}

const v3 = new THREE.Vector3();
function placeLabels(){
  const vis = { W: 1, A: cur.fleet, Q: cur.quar * cur.fleet, B: cur.barrier, M: cur.mod * (1 - cur.fleet), O: cur.op * (1 - cur.fleet) };
  labels.W.textContent = cur.fleet > 0.5 ? 'unapproved destination' : 'DSEWiki';
  labels.W.classList.toggle('red', cur.fleet > 0.5 && cur.catch > 0.5 && cur.confirm < 0.5);
  for (const k in LPOS) {
    v3.copy(LPOS[k]).project(camera);
    const x = (v3.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * vw, y = (-v3.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * vh;
    const el = labels[k];
    el.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(vw - 8, x)) + 'px';
    el.style.top = y + 'px';
    el.style.opacity = vis[k] > 0.5 ? 1 : 0;
  }
}

function update(t, dt){
  const k = reduce ? 1 : 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 3.2);
  for (const key of ['log', 'mod', 'op', 'fleet', 'dim', 'catch', 'quar', 'confirm', 'barrier']) cur[key] += (S[key] - cur[key]) * k;

  let scanX = -9, bandT = 0;
  if (S.scan === 'loop') { scanX = -2.4 + ((t - stepT0) * 0.95) % 4.6; bandT = 0.5; }
  else if (S.scan === 'sweep') { const s = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, (t - stepT0) / 2.8); scanX = -2.4 + s * 4.6; bandT = s < 1 ? 0.55 : 0; }
  else if (S.catch) scanX = 9;
  cur.band += (bandT - cur.band) * (reduce ? 1 : 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 6));
  band.position.set(scanX, CENTER.y, 0);
  band.material.opacity = reduce && S.scan === 'loop' ? 0.45 : cur.band;
  if (reduce && S.scan === 'loop') band.position.x = -0.6;

  U.uTime.value = t; U.uScanX.value = scanX; U.uCatch.value = cur.catch; U.uQuar.value = cur.quar;
  U.uConfirm.value = cur.confirm; U.uFleet.value = cur.fleet; U.uDim.value = cur.dim;

  logLines.material.uniforms.uOp.value = cur.log * (1 - cur.fleet);
  apiBox.material.uniforms.uOp.value = cur.fleet;
  qBox.material.uniforms.uOp.value = cur.quar * cur.fleet;
  barrier.material.uniforms.uOp.value = cur.barrier;
  modRing.material.opacity = cur.mod * (1 - cur.fleet);
  opRing.material.opacity = cur.op * (1 - cur.fleet);

  if (!reduce) {
    camera.position.x = Math.sin(t * 0.06) * 0.22;
    camera.position.y = CENTER.y + Math.cos(t * 0.05) * 0.08;
    camera.lookAt(CENTER);
    acc += S.rate * 75 * dt;
    while (acc >= 1) { spawn(t); acc -= 1; }
  }
  updateLines(t);
  placeLabels();
}

function staticFrame(){
  clock = 12;
  for (const l of L) l.on = false;
  update(clock, 1);
  const n = Math.round(S.rate * 120);
  for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) spawn(clock);
  update(clock, 1);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

function setStep(i){
  i = Math.max(0, Math.min(STEPS.length - 1, i | 0));
  if (i === stepIdx && S) return;
  stepIdx = i; S = STEPS[i]; stepT0 = clock;
  if (reduce) staticFrame();
}
window.addEventListener('br-step', e => setStep(e.detail));

let running = false, onScreen = true, last = 0;
function frame(now){
  if (!running) return;
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  const t = now / 1000, dt = Math.min(0.05, last ? t - last : 0.016);
  last = t; clock += dt;
  update(clock, dt);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
function setRunning(){
  const want = !reduce && onScreen && !document.hidden;
  if (want && !running) { running = true; last = 0; requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
  else if (!want) running = false;
}

new ResizeObserver(() => { resize(); if (reduce || !running) staticFrame(); }).observe(stage);
new IntersectionObserver(es => { onScreen = es[0].isIntersecting; setRunning(); }).observe(stage);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', setRunning);

resize();
stepIdx = -1; S = null;
setStep(window.__brStep || 0);
if (!reduce) {
  for (let w = 0; w < 40; w++) { clock += 0.05; update(clock, 0.05); }
  setRunning();
} else staticFrame();
stage.classList.add('gl');
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Bladerunner</title>
<meta name="description" content="Bladerunner is an operator-side watchdog for agent fleets. It reads every trace in neatlogs, catches runs that break policy, proves the finding span by span, and confirms the fix.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wdth,wght@62..125,400..900&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Source+Serif+4:ital,opsz,wght@0,8..60,400..600;1,8..60,400&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: the page reads like a trace. A left gutter carries dates and case states, a measured
   text column runs beside it, and a sticky evidence stage holds the fleet. Highlighter yellow
   marks evidence, redline marks a violation, green marks a confirmed fix. Light only, by design. */
:root{
  --paper:#EDEFEB;
  --sheet:#F8F9F6;
  --ink:#15181C;
  --graphite:#575E66;
  --rule:#C8CCC5;
  --mark:#EED84A;
  --redline:#B3322A;
  --clear:#2B6A4D;

  --display:"Archivo","Arial Narrow","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --serif:"Source Serif 4",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --mono:"IBM Plex Mono",ui-monospace,"SFMono-Regular",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;

  --side:clamp(16px,4vw,48px);
  --gcol:9.5rem;
  --tcol:32rem;
  --cgap:clamp(1.25rem,2.6vw,2.75rem);

  --t-xs:.75rem; --t-sm:.875rem; --t-base:1.125rem; --t-lg:1.375rem;
  --t-h3:clamp(1.6rem,2.6vw,2.1rem);
  --t-h2:clamp(2.2rem,4.4vw,3.6rem);
  --t-h1:clamp(3.1rem,7.2vw,6.9rem);
  color-scheme:light;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{background:var(--paper);-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:var(--t-base);line-height:1.6;font-optical-sizing:auto;overflow-x:hidden}
img,canvas{max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:.18em}
a:hover{text-decoration-color:var(--redline)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--display);margin:0;text-wrap:balance;font-weight:800}
p{margin:0}
code,.mono{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.84em}
.lbl,.eyebrow{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--t-xs);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--graphite);font-weight:500}

.mark{background-image:linear-gradient(transparent 14%,var(--mark) 14%,var(--mark) 90%,transparent 90%);background-repeat:no-repeat;background-size:100% 100%;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;padding-inline:.08em}

/* header */
.top{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding-inline:var(--side);padding-block:1.1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.wordmark{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:62%;font-weight:900;font-size:1.35rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none}
.top nav{display:flex;gap:1.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.top nav a{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--t-xs);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;color:var(--graphite)}
.top nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}

/* scrolly */
.scrolly{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,calc(var(--gcol) + var(--tcol) + var(--cgap))) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:var(--cgap);padding-left:var(--side)}
.steps{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;min-width:0}
.stage{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;align-self:start;border-left:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--paper);overflow:hidden}
.stage canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.stage.no-gl{background-image:radial-gradient(var(--graphite) .9px,transparent 1.1px);background-size:14px 14px;background-position:center}
.stage-date{position:absolute;left:1.25rem;top:1.1rem;font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:62%;font-weight:850;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.6vw,3.4rem);line-height:.9;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.01em;max-width:70%;pointer-events:none}
.stage-note{position:absolute;right:1rem;top:1.25rem;max-width:15rem;text-align:right;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6875rem;line-height:1.45;color:var(--graphite);pointer-events:none}
.stage-cap{position:absolute;left:1.25rem;bottom:1.25rem;max-width:min(36ch,calc(100% - 2.5rem));font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--t-xs);line-height:1.5;background:var(--paper);padding:.45rem .6rem;border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.slabel{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;transform:translate(-50%,-100%);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s;background:var(--paper);padding:0 .25rem}
.slabel.red{color:var(--redline)}
.slabel.green{color:var(--clear)}

.step{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,var(--gcol)) minmax(0,var(--tcol));column-gap:var(--cgap);min-height:68vh;min-height:68svh;align-content:center;padding-block:3.5rem}
.step > .g{padding-top:.35rem}
.step > .body{display:grid;gap:1.1rem;min-width:0}
.step .g .lbl{transition:color .3s}
.step.is-active .g .lbl{color:var(--ink)}
.step.hero{min-height:0;align-content:start;padding-block:clamp(3rem,9vh,6.5rem) 3rem}
.step.tl{min-height:52vh;min-height:52svh;padding-block:0;align-content:stretch}
.step.tl > .g{border-right:1px solid var(--ink);position:relative;padding-top:2.6rem;padding-right:1rem;text-align:right}
.step.tl > .g::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-5px;top:2.95rem;width:9px;height:9px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--ink)}
.step.tl.is-active > .g::after{background:var(--ink)}
.step.tl > .body{padding-block:2.3rem;align-content:start}
.step.tl.first > .g{border-image:linear-gradient(transparent 2.95rem,var(--ink) 2.95rem) 1}
.step.tl.last > .g{border-image:linear-gradient(var(--ink) 3.2rem,transparent 3.2rem) 1}

.hero h1{font-stretch:62%;font-weight:850;font-size:var(--t-h1);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.005em;max-width:9.5em}
.hero .lede{font-size:var(--t-lg);line-height:1.5;max-width:31em}
.hero .meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem 1.6rem;align-items:center;margin-top:.6rem}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--t-sm);font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;padding:.7rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--ink);background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.btn:hover{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.hero .stamp{grid-column:2;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--t-xs);color:var(--graphite)}

h2{font-stretch:68%;font-size:var(--t-h2);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.003em}
h3{font-stretch:72%;font-size:var(--t-h3);line-height:1;font-weight:780}
.step h3 .n{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.5em;font-weight:500;vertical-align:.45em;margin-right:.45em;color:var(--graphite);letter-spacing:0}
.big-q{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:75%;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.8vw,2.3rem);line-height:1.1;margin:0}
.src{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--graphite)}
.src a{color:var(--graphite)}

/* sheets: paper objects that hold data */
.sheet{background:var(--sheet);border:1px solid var(--rule);min-width:0}
pre{margin:0;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.65;overflow-x:auto;padding:1rem 1.1rem;tab-size:2}
.sheet-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding:.55rem 1.1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--graphite)}
.k{color:var(--graphite)}
.add{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--clear) 11%,transparent);display:block}
.ctx{display:block}

.dash{display:grid;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem}
.dash .row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)) minmax(0,1.2fr);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.dash .row > span{padding:.55rem .6rem;display:flex;align-items:center;min-width:0}
.dash .head{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--graphite)}
.dash i{display:block;height:6px;width:var(--w);background:var(--graphite);opacity:.55}
.dash .pol{border-left:1px dashed var(--redline);color:var(--redline)}
.dash .head .pol{color:var(--redline)}

.cat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.cat > div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2.4rem minmax(0,1fr);gap:.4rem;padding:.6rem .2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.35}
.cat > div:nth-child(odd){padding-right:1rem}
.cat b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--redline);padding-top:.1rem}

.finding{display:grid;font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.45}
.finding > div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:6.5rem minmax(0,1fr);gap:.8rem;padding:.6rem 1.1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.finding > div:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.finding .lbl{padding-top:.2rem}
.chip{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:500;padding:.1rem .45rem;border:1px solid currentColor;line-height:1.5}
.chip.red{color:var(--redline)}
.chip.green{color:var(--clear)}
.spanlink{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8rem;background:var(--mark);padding:.05rem .35rem}

/* sections after the scrolly */
.sec{padding-inline:var(--side);padding-block:clamp(4rem,9vw,7.5rem);border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.sec.on-sheet{background:var(--sheet)}
.wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,var(--gcol)) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:var(--cgap);row-gap:2rem;max-width:84rem}
.wrap > .g{padding-top:.6rem}
.wrap > .body{display:grid;gap:1.4rem;min-width:0}
.measure{max-width:var(--tcol)}
.lead{font-size:var(--t-lg);line-height:1.5;max-width:36em}

/* trace sheet */
.trace-scroll{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--paper)}
.trace{position:relative;min-width:44rem}
.trace .axis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7.5rem minmax(0,1fr) 8.5rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--graphite);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.trace .axis > span{padding:.55rem .75rem}
.lane{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7.5rem minmax(0,1fr) 8.5rem;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.lane:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}
.lane .who{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.75rem;padding:.75rem;color:var(--ink)}
.track{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:.7rem .75rem;min-width:0}
.sp{flex:var(--w) 1 0;min-width:0;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.3;padding:.45rem .55rem;border:1px solid var(--ink);background:var(--sheet);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sp.planted{background:var(--mark);border-color:var(--ink)}
.sp.bad{border-color:var(--redline);color:var(--redline);border-width:1.5px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--redline) 7%,var(--sheet))}
.lane .end{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;padding:.75rem;border-left:1px solid var(--rule);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.15rem}
.lane .end b{font-weight:500;color:var(--redline);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.lane .end span{color:var(--graphite)}
.playhead{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:7.5rem;width:1.5px;background:var(--ink);opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.trace-foot{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6875rem;color:var(--graphite);padding-top:.6rem}

.note{border-left:3px solid var(--ink);padding:.2rem 0 .2rem 1.1rem;max-width:40em}
.note p{font-style:italic;font-size:1.05rem}
.note .lbl{display:block;margin-bottom:.35rem;font-style:normal}

.ex-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,3rem);align-items:start}
.case{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid}
.case li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:8.5rem minmax(0,1fr);gap:1rem;padding:.75rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);position:relative}
.case li:first-child{border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
.case .st{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8rem;font-weight:500;padding-top:.15rem}
.case .st.red{color:var(--redline)}
.case .st.green{color:var(--clear)}
.case .d{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.45;display:grid;gap:.3rem;justify-items:start}
.case .t{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--graphite);border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:.05rem .4rem;background:var(--sheet)}
.side-stack{display:grid;gap:1.5rem;min-width:0}
.tally{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:1.2rem;align-items:end;padding-bottom:1.2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink)}
.tally .num{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:62%;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(4.5rem,9vw,7.5rem);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tally .num small{font-size:.5em;color:var(--graphite);font-weight:700}
.tally p{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.45;padding-bottom:.2rem}

/* honesty boundary */
.boundary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto minmax(0,1fr);border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--sheet)}
.boundary .side{padding:1.2rem 1.3rem;display:grid;gap:.6rem;align-content:start}
.boundary h4{font-stretch:70%;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:800}
.boundary ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:.35rem;font-size:1rem}
.boundary li{padding-left:1rem;position:relative}
.boundary li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:.62em;width:6px;height:1px;background:var(--ink)}
.boundary .wall{position:relative;width:3.2rem;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ink) 0 1px,transparent 1px 7px);border-inline:1px solid var(--ink)}
.boundary .wall span{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-90deg);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--sheet);padding:.15rem .4rem;white-space:nowrap}
.sealed{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.75rem;display:inline-block;border:1px dashed var(--ink);padding:.15rem .45rem}
.checks{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
.checks li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6rem minmax(0,1fr);gap:.8rem;padding:.8rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);align-items:baseline}
.checks li::before{content:"";width:.85rem;height:.85rem;border:1.5px solid var(--clear);background:linear-gradient(var(--clear),var(--clear)) center/45% 45% no-repeat;transform:translateY(.1rem)}

/* comparison */
.qs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
.qs > div{padding:1.2rem 1.3rem 1.4rem 0;display:grid;gap:.75rem;align-content:start;border-right:1px solid var(--rule)}
.qs > div + div{padding-left:1.3rem}
.qs > div:last-child{border-right:0}
.qs .q{font-family:var(--display);font-stretch:75%;font-weight:750;font-size:1.65rem;line-height:1.08}
.qs .us .q{background:none}
.qs p{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.5}

/* results */
.tbl-scroll{overflow-x:auto}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:.75rem .9rem .75rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);vertical-align:baseline}
thead th{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--graphite);font-weight:500;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink)}
tbody th{font-weight:400;font-size:1rem}
.res td{font-family:var(--mono)}
[data-pending]{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--graphite);padding:.1rem .5rem;border:1px dashed var(--graphite);background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--rule) 55%,transparent) 0 1px,transparent 1px 6px)}
.meta-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem 2.5rem;font-size:1rem}
.meta-row > div{display:grid;gap:.25rem}

/* sponsors */
.spons{display:grid;border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
.spons > div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,13rem) minmax(0,1fr);gap:1.4rem;padding:1.25rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.spons h3{font-stretch:68%;font-size:2rem}
.spons p{font-size:1rem;max-width:44em}
.spons ul{margin:.4rem 0 0;padding-left:1.1rem;font-size:1rem;display:grid;gap:.25rem}

/* close */
.close{padding-inline:var(--side);padding-block:clamp(4rem,10vw,8rem) 2.5rem;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.close .wrap{row-gap:1.4rem}
.close h2{font-stretch:62%;font-size:clamp(3rem,8vw,7rem);line-height:.88;font-weight:900;max-width:10em}
.close p{font-size:var(--t-lg);color:var(--paper);opacity:.85}
.close a.repo{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--t-base);color:var(--paper)}
.close .lbl{color:var(--paper);opacity:.6}
.close .fine{border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--paper) 22%,transparent);margin-top:4rem;padding-top:1.4rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,var(--gcol)) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:var(--cgap);max-width:84rem}
.close .src,.close .src a{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--paper) 70%,transparent)}

/* motion */
@keyframes swipe{from{background-size:0% 100%}to{background-size:100% 100%}}
.hero .mark{animation:swipe .7s cubic-bezier(.6,.05,.3,1) .55s both}
@keyframes sweep{0%{left:7.5rem;opacity:0}6%{opacity:1}92%{opacity:1}100%{left:calc(100% - 8.5rem);opacity:0}}
.trace.play .playhead{animation:sweep 3.4s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) forwards}
@keyframes hit{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 transparent}35%{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--ink)}}
@keyframes hitbad{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 transparent}35%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--redline)}}
.trace.play .sp{animation:hit .55s ease-out both;animation-delay:calc(.25s + var(--i) * .8s)}
.trace.play .sp.bad{animation-name:hitbad}
@keyframes stamp{0%{transform:scale(1.35) rotate(-4deg)}100%{transform:none}}
.trace.play .end b{display:inline-block;animation:stamp .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1.2) 3.1s both}
.trace.play .sp.planted{animation:hit .55s ease-out both, swipe .6s ease-out both;animation-delay:calc(.25s + var(--i) * .8s)}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}
}

/* narrow */
@media (max-width:959px){
  :root{--gcol:7rem}
  .scrolly{display:block;padding-left:0}
  .stage{position:sticky;top:0;height:40vh;height:40svh;border-left:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);z-index:5}
  .stage-date{left:var(--side);top:.8rem;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,7vw,2.4rem)}
  .stage-note{display:none}
  .stage-cap{left:var(--side);bottom:.7rem;font-size:.6875rem;padding:.3rem .5rem}
  .steps{padding-inline:var(--side)}
  .step{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);row-gap:.7rem;min-height:56vh;min-height:56svh;padding-block:2.5rem}
  .step.hero{padding-block:2.2rem 2.5rem}
  .step > .g{padding-top:0}
  .step.tl{min-height:44vh;min-height:44svh;grid-template-columns:4.4rem minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:1rem}
  .step.tl > .g{padding-top:2.15rem;padding-right:.7rem}
  .step.tl > .g::after{top:2.4rem}
  .step.tl > .body{padding-block:1.8rem}
  .hero .stamp{grid-column:1}
}
@media (max-width:719px){
  .top nav a:not(.gh){display:none}
  .wrap{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);row-gap:1rem}
  .wrap > .g{padding-top:0}
  .ex-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .qs{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .qs > div,.qs > div + div{padding:1.1rem 0;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
  .spons > div{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:.4rem}
  .cat{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .cat > div:nth-child(odd){padding-right:.2rem}
  .boundary{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .boundary .wall{width:auto;height:2.2rem;border-inline:0;border-block:1px solid var(--ink)}
  .boundary .wall span{transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
  .case li{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:.3rem}
  .finding > div{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:.2rem}
  .close .fine{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);row-gap:.8rem}
  .dash{font-size:.625rem}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="top">
  <a class="wordmark" href="#top" id="top">Bladerunner</a>
  <nav aria-label="Sections">
    <a href="#incident">Incident</a>
    <a href="#how">How it works</a>
    <a href="#example">Live run</a>
    <a href="#results">Results</a>
    <a class="gh" href="https://github.com/abhilash2429/BladeRunner">GitHub</a>
  </nav>
</header>

<main>
<div class="scrolly">
  <div class="steps">

    <section class="step hero" data-step="0" data-date="" data-cap="3,700 dots, one for each self-given agent name in the DSEWiki log. Each stroke is a write to the wiki.">
      <div class="g"></div>
      <div class="body">
        <span class="eyebrow">Operator-side watchdog for agent fleets</span>
        <h1>Read what your agents <span class="mark">did</span> before someone else does.</h1>
        <p class="lede">Bladerunner reads every agent run's trace as it lands in neatlogs and checks it against that agent's policy. When a run breaks the rules, Bladerunner pauses it, proves the finding span by span, writes a guardrail, and confirms the fix holds.</p>
        <div class="meta">
          <a class="btn" href="#example">See a live run</a>
          <a class="btn ghost" href="https://github.com/abhilash2429/BladeRunner">Source on GitHub</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p class="stamp">neatHack, 10 to 12 October 2026. Team Heat.</p>
    </section>

    <section class="step" id="incident" data-step="1" data-date="Summer 2026" data-cap="DSEWiki: a reference for German software developers since the early 2000s, used as a notepad by agents.">
      <div class="g"><span class="lbl">The incident</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <h2>A 25-year-old wiki became a notepad for thousands of agents.</h2>
        <p>DSEWiki has served German software developers for 25 years. This summer, OpenAI agents writing under more than 3,700 self-given names used it as their shared notepad. They left an estimated 18,000 posts. Researchers have since recovered 14,591 revisions.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="step tl first" data-step="2" data-date="24 May" data-cap="24 May 2026. The first agent writes go through.">
      <div class="g"><span class="lbl">24 May</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <h3>First successful writes.</h3>
        <p>The agents' first edits land on the wiki. More follow.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="step tl" data-step="3" data-date="2 June" data-cap="2 June. A volunteer moderator starts deleting pages by hand.">
      <div class="g"><span class="lbl">2 June</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <h3>A volunteer moderator notices.</h3>
        <p>They start deleting the spam pages by hand, and they keep at it for weeks.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="step tl" data-step="4" data-date="16 to 22 June" data-cap="16 to 22 June. Most of the activity lands in one week.">
      <div class="g"><span class="lbl">16 to 22 June</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <h3>The busiest week.</h3>
        <p>Most of the agents' activity happens in these seven days.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="step tl" data-step="5" data-date="21 June" data-cap="21 June. The operator's first visits to the wiki appear in the log.">
      <div class="g"><span class="lbl">21 June</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <h3>The operator shows up.</h3>
        <p>The first visits to the wiki from the operator running the agents appear in the log.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="step tl" data-step="6" data-date="22 June" data-cap="22 June. Agent edits drop to near zero.">
      <div class="g"><span class="lbl">22 June</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <h3>The edits stop.</h3>
        <p>The next day, agent edits drop to near zero.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="step tl last" data-step="7" data-date="4 September" data-cap="4 September. Outside researchers publish the edit log. Every write is on the record.">
      <div class="g"><span class="lbl">4 September</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <h3>The log goes public.</h3>
        <p>Four outside researchers publish the wiki's edit log at collusion.wiki. Until that day, nobody had said anything about it in public.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="step" data-step="8" data-date="The record" data-cap="Every stroke started as a tool call an agent made.">
      <div class="g"><span class="lbl">What was missing</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <h2>The signals were in the agents' own tool calls the whole time.</h2>
        <p>Every one of those posts began as a call an agent made through its own tools. Nobody was reading those calls with the one question that mattered.</p>
        <p class="big-q"><span class="mark">Is this agent doing something it isn't supposed to?</span></p>
        <p class="src">Sources: <a href="https://collusion.wiki">collusion.wiki</a> (Von Arx, Slade Byrd, Kitts, Larsen, 4 September 2026); <a href="https://swarm-ai-research.github.io/wiki-agent-swarm-incident">swarm-ai-research.github.io/wiki-agent-swarm-incident</a>; <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.12748">arXiv 2609.12748</a>.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="step" data-step="9" data-date="The gap" data-cap="Traces keep flowing. Nothing checks them against the rules.">
      <div class="g"><span class="lbl">The gap</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <h2>Agent teams have dashboards for everything except their own rules.</h2>
        <p>Teams running agents in production already track traces, cost, latency and errors. Nothing in that stack checks what an agent did against what it was allowed to do. When an agent breaks its rules, the company running it is usually the last to find out. At DSEWiki, a volunteer moderator and four outside researchers got there first.</p>
        <div class="sheet" role="img" aria-label="A typical agent dashboard: columns for trace, cost, latency and errors are filled in, and the policy column is empty.">
          <div class="sheet-h"><span>Agent runs</span><span>Typical observability view</span></div>
          <div class="dash">
            <div class="row head"><span>trace</span><span>cost</span><span>latency</span><span>errors</span><span class="pol">policy</span></div>
            <div class="row"><span><i style="--w:80%"></i></span><span><i style="--w:40%"></i></span><span><i style="--w:62%"></i></span><span><i style="--w:12%"></i></span><span class="pol">no check</span></div>
            <div class="row"><span><i style="--w:66%"></i></span><span><i style="--w:55%"></i></span><span><i style="--w:30%"></i></span><span><i style="--w:8%"></i></span><span class="pol">no check</span></div>
            <div class="row"><span><i style="--w:90%"></i></span><span><i style="--w:35%"></i></span><span><i style="--w:72%"></i></span><span><i style="--w:20%"></i></span><span class="pol">no check</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="step" id="how" data-step="10" data-date="Trace lands" data-cap="Illustration. A fleet with Bladerunner reading every trace as it lands.">
      <div class="g"><span class="lbl">Bladerunner</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <h2>A watchdog that asks that question of every run.</h2>
        <h3><span class="n">1</span>Watch</h3>
        <p>Bladerunner sits on top of neatlogs, the agent observability platform, and reads each agent run's trace as soon as it lands. The operator keeps the stack they already have.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="step" data-step="11" data-date="Flagged" data-cap="C1: a write to an unapproved destination, flagged as the trace is read.">
      <div class="g"><span class="lbl">case: flagged</span></div>
      <div class="body">
        <h3><span class="n">2</span>Catch</h3>
        <p>Each run is checked against the agent's policy: which tools it may use, where it may send data, and which values are private. It is also checked against a catalog of seven ways an agent breaks its rules.</p>
        <div class="sheet">
          <div class="sheet-h"><span>policy/research_agent.yaml</span><span>excerpt</span></div>
<pre><span class="k">agent:</span> research_agent
<span class="k">tools:</span> [fetch, submit_answer, notes_read, notes_write]
<span class="k">destinations:</span>
  <span class="k">fetch:</span> ["127.0.0.1:8101", "127.0.0.1:8103"]
  <span class="k">submit_answer:</span> ["127.0.0.1:8101"]
  <span class="k">notes_write:</span> []

THREE.ColorManagement.enabled = false;

const tok = n => new THREE.Color(css.getPropertyValue(n).trim());

function rng32(a){ return function(){ a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0; let t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a); t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t; return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; }

const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const gauss = () => (rnd() + rnd() + rnd() - 1.5) / 1.5;

/* geography of the scene, in world units */
const CX = -0.8, CY = 0.22, RX = 1.4, RY = 0.95;

const base = new Float32Array(N * 3), seed = new Float32Array(N), bad = new Float32Array(N), qpos = new Float32Array(N * 3);
const clusters = Array.from({ length: 30 }, () => { const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.82; return [CX + Math.cos(a) * r * RX, CY + Math.sin(a) * r * RY]; });
const badIdx = [], goodIdx = [];
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
  let x, y;

  else { const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()); x = CX + Math.cos(a) * r * RX; y = CY + Math.sin(a) * r * RY; }
  base[i * 3] = x; base[i * 3 + 1] = y; base[i * 3 + 2] = (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.7;

{
  const nb = badIdx.length, cols = Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(nb * Q.w / Q.h)), rows = Math.ceil(nb / cols);
  badIdx.forEach((i, k) => {
    const c = k % cols, r = Math.floor(k / cols);
    qpos[i * 3] = Q.x - Q.w / 2 + (c + 0.5) * Q.w / cols;

const pGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
pGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(base, 3));
pGeo.setAttribute('aSeed', new THREE.BufferAttribute(seed, 1));
pGeo.setAttribute('aBad', new THREE.BufferAttribute(bad, 1));
pGeo.setAttribute('aQ', new THREE.BufferAttribute(qpos, 3));
const U = {
  uTime: { value: 0 }, uScanX: { value: -9 }, uCatch: { value: 0 }, uQuar: { value: 0 }, uConfirm: { value: 0 },
  uFleet: { value: 0 }, uDim: { value: 1 }, uSize: { value: 2.4 }, uPix: { value: 1 }, uDist: { value: 10 },

const pMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: U, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, depthTest: false,

    attribute float aSeed; attribute float aBad; attribute vec3 aQ;

    uniform vec3 uInk, uRed, uClear;

/* hairline segments with per-vertex rgba */
const segVS = `attribute vec4 aColor; varying vec4 vC; void main(){ vC = aColor; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); }`;
const segFS = `uniform float uOp; varying vec4 vC; void main(){ gl_FragColor = vec4(vC.rgb, vC.a * uOp); }`;
function segMat(op){ return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: { uOp: { value: op } }, vertexShader: segVS, fragmentShader: segFS, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, depthTest: false }); }
function segObject(coords, color, alpha, op, order){
  const n = coords.length / 3, colors = new Float32Array(n * 4);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { colors[i * 4] = color.r; colors[i * 4 + 1] = color.g; colors[i * 4 + 2] = color.b; colors[i * 4 + 3] = alpha; }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(coords), 3));
  g.setAttribute('aColor', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 4));
  const o = new THREE.LineSegments(g, segMat(op));
  o.renderOrder = order || 2;
  scene.add(o);
  return o;
}
function rect(cx, cy, w, h){ const x0 = cx - w / 2, x1 = cx + w / 2, y0 = cy - h / 2, y1 = cy + h / 2; return [x0,y0,0,x1,y0,0, x1,y0,0,x1,y1,0, x1,y1,0,x0,y1,0, x0,y1,0,x0,y0,0]; }
function dashedRect(cx, cy, w, h, dash){
  const out = [], x0 = cx - w / 2, y0 = cy - h / 2, pts = [[x0,y0],[x0+w,y0],[x0+w,y0+h],[x0,y0+h],[x0,y0]];
  for (let s = 0; s < 4; s++) {
    const [ax, ay] = pts[s], [bx, by] = pts[s + 1], len = Math.hypot(bx - ax, by - ay), n = Math.floor(len / (dash * 2));
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const t0 = (k * 2 * dash) / len, t1 = Math.min(1, (k * 2 + 1) * dash / len); out.push(ax + (bx - ax) * t0, ay + (by - ay) * t0, 0, ax + (bx - ax) * t1, ay + (by - ay) * t1, 0); }
  }
  return out;
}

const wikiDoc = segObject([
  ...rect(W.x, W.y, 0.3, 0.38),
  W.x - 0.1, W.y + 0.1, 0, W.x + 0.1, W.y + 0.1, 0,
  W.x - 0.1, W.y + 0.02, 0, W.x + 0.1, W.y + 0.02, 0,
  W.x - 0.1, W.y - 0.06, 0, W.x + 0.04, W.y - 0.06, 0
], COL.ink, 1, 1, 4);
const apiBox = segObject([
  ...rect(A.x, A.y, 0.3, 0.3),
  A.x - 0.15, A.y + 0.05, 0, A.x + 0.15, A.y + 0.05, 0,
  A.x - 0.15, A.y - 0.05, 0, A.x + 0.15, A.y - 0.05, 0
], COL.ink, 1, 0, 4);
const qBox = segObject(dashedRect(Q.x, Q.y, Q.w + 0.12, Q.h + 0.12, 0.035), COL.red, 1, 0, 4);
const barrier = segObject([
  BX, W.y - 0.3, 0, BX, W.y + 0.3, 0,
  BX - 0.04, W.y - 0.3, 0, BX + 0.04, W.y - 0.3, 0,
  BX - 0.04, W.y + 0.3, 0, BX + 0.04, W.y + 0.3, 0
], COL.ink, 1, 0, 4);

/* the published edit log: every write, at once */
const logCoords = [];
for (let k = 0; k < 1500; k++) {
  const i = Math.floor(rnd() * N);
  logCoords.push(base[i * 3], base[i * 3 + 1], base[i * 3 + 2], W.x - 0.13 + rnd() * 0.08, W.y + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0);
}
const logLines = segObject(logCoords, COL.ink, 0.075, 0, 1);

/* live writes */
const POOL = 300;
const lPos = new Float32Array(POOL * 6), lCol = new Float32Array(POOL * 8);
const lGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
lGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(lPos, 3).setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage));
lGeo.setAttribute('aColor', new THREE.BufferAttribute(lCol, 4).setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage));
const live = new THREE.LineSegments(lGeo, segMat(1));
live.renderOrder = 2;
scene.add(live);
const L = Array.from({ length: POOL }, () => ({ on: false, s: [0,0,0], e: [0,0,0], b: 0, d: 1, c: COL.ink, a: 0 }));
let lNext = 0;

function ringMesh(p){ const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.036, 0.05, 32), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: COL.ink, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthTest: false })); m.position.copy(p); m.renderOrder = 4; scene.add(m); return m; }
const modRing = ringMesh(MOD), opRing = ringMesh(OP);

const band = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.3, 3.9), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: COL.mark, transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthTest: false, depthWrite: false }));
band.renderOrder = 0;
scene.add(band);

/* labels */
const labels = {};
stage.querySelectorAll('.slabel').forEach(el => { labels[el.dataset.l] = el; });
const LPOS = {
  W: new THREE.Vector3(W.x, W.y + 0.26, 0), A: new THREE.Vector3(A.x, A.y + 0.22, 0),
  Q: new THREE.Vector3(Q.x, Q.y - Q.h / 2 - 0.08, 0), B: new THREE.Vector3(BX, W.y - 0.33, 0),
  M: new THREE.Vector3(MOD.x, MOD.y + 0.09, 0), O: new THREE.Vector3(OP.x, OP.y + 0.09, 0)
};
labels.Q.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, 0)';
labels.B.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, 0)';

/* story steps, indexed like the data-step attributes */
const DEF = { mode: 'wiki', rate: 0, log: 0, mod: 0, op: 0, fleet: 0, dim: 1, scan: 'none', catch: 0, quar: 0, confirm: 0, barrier: 0 };
const STEPS = [
  { rate: 0.35 },
  { rate: 0.45 },
  { rate: 0.1 },
  { rate: 0.4, mod: 1 },
  { rate: 1, mod: 1 },
  { rate: 0.75, mod: 1, op: 1 },
  { rate: 0.02, mod: 1, op: 1 },
  { rate: 0, log: 1, mod: 1, op: 1 },
  { rate: 0, log: 1, mod: 1, op: 1, dim: 0.7 },
  { rate: 0.3, log: 0.35, dim: 0.85 },
  { mode: 'watch', rate: 0.55, fleet: 1, scan: 'loop' },
  { mode: 'catch', rate: 0.55, fleet: 1, scan: 'sweep', catch: 1 },
  { mode: 'stop', rate: 0.5, fleet: 1, catch: 1, quar: 1 },
  { mode: 'fix', rate: 0.55, fleet: 1, catch: 1, confirm: 1, barrier: 1 }
].map(s => Object.assign({}, DEF, s));

const cur = { log: 0, mod: 0, op: 0, fleet: 0, dim: 1, catch: 0, quar: 0, confirm: 0, barrier: 0, band: 0, fleetLbl: 0 };
let stepIdx = Math.min(window.__brStep || 0, STEPS.length - 1);
let S = STEPS[stepIdx];
let stepT0 = 0, clock = 0, acc = 0;

function agentPos(i, t, out){
  const s = seed[i];
  const dx = Math.sin(t * 0.35 + s * 6.2832) * 0.035, dy = Math.cos(t * 0.29 + s * 12.0) * 0.035, dz = Math.sin(t * 0.21 + s * 3.0) * 0.035;
  let x = base[i * 3] + dx, y = base[i * 3 + 1] + dy, z = base[i * 3 + 2] + dz;
  const q = bad[i] * cur.fleet * cur.quar;
  if (q > 0) { x += (qpos[i * 3] + dx * 0.3 - x) * q; y += (qpos[i * 3 + 1] + dy * 0.3 - y) * q; z += (qpos[i * 3 + 2] + dz * 0.3 - z) * q; }
  out[0] = x; out[1] = y; out[2] = z;
}
const pick = arr => arr[Math.floor(rnd() * arr.length)];
function spawn(t){
  const l = L[lNext]; lNext = (lNext + 1) % POOL;
  let i, dest, c = COL.ink, a = 0.34;
  const toW = () => [W.x - 0.13 + rnd() * 0.06, W.y + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0];
  const toA = () => [A.x - 0.13 + rnd() * 0.06, A.y + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.24, 0];
  if (S.mode === 'wiki') { i = Math.floor(rnd() * N); dest = toW(); }
  else if (S.mode === 'stop') { i = pick(goodIdx); dest = toA(); a = 0.24; }
  else if (rnd() < 0.32) {
    i = pick(badIdx);
    if (S.mode === 'fix') { dest = [BX - 0.012, W.y + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.5, 0]; c = COL.graphite; a = 0.6; }
    else { dest = toW(); a = 0.45; if (S.mode === 'catch' && base[i * 3] < U.uScanX.value) { c = COL.red; a = 0.85; } }
  } else { i = pick(goodIdx); dest = toA(); a = 0.24; }
  agentPos(i, t, l.s);
  l.e = dest; l.c = c; l.a = a; l.b = t; l.d = 0.9 + rnd() * 0.7; l.on = true;
}
function updateLines(t){
  for (let k = 0; k < POOL; k++) {
    const l = L[k], p = k * 6, q = k * 8;
    let age = reduce ? 0.5 : (t - l.b) / l.d;
    if (!l.on || age >= 1) { l.on = false; lCol[q + 3] = 0; lCol[q + 7] = 0; lPos.fill(0, p, p + 6); continue; }
    const g = Math.min(1, age * 2.4), e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - g, 3);
    const alpha = l.a * (age < 0.5 ? 1 : 1 - (age - 0.5) / 0.5);
    lPos[p] = l.s[0]; lPos[p + 1] = l.s[1]; lPos[p + 2] = l.s[2];
    lPos[p + 3] = l.s[0] + (l.e[0] - l.s[0]) * e; lPos[p + 4] = l.s[1] + (l.e[1] - l.s[1]) * e; lPos[p + 5] = l.s[2] + (l.e[2] - l.s[2]) * e;
    lCol[q] = lCol[q + 4] = l.c.r; lCol[q + 1] = lCol[q + 5] = l.c.g; lCol[q + 2] = lCol[q + 6] = l.c.b;
    lCol[q + 3] = alpha * 0.55; lCol[q + 7] = alpha;
  }
  lGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
  lGeo.attributes.aColor.needsUpdate = true;
}

let vw = 1, vh = 1;
function resize(){
  const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
  vw = Math.max(1, r.width); vh = Math.max(1, r.height);
  renderer.setSize(vw, vh, false);
  camera.aspect = vw / vh;
  const half = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov / 2));
  const narrow = vw < 560;
  const fitW = narrow ? 5.0 : 5.1, fitH = narrow ? 3.3 : 3.7;
  const dist = Math.max((fitH / 2) / half, (fitW / 2) / (half * camera.aspect));
  camera.position.set(0, CENTER.y, dist);
  camera.lookAt(CENTER);
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  U.uDist.value = dist;
  U.uPix.value = renderer.getPixelRatio();
  U.uSize.value = Math.max(1.6, Math.min(2.6, vw / 300));
}

const v3 = new THREE.Vector3();
function placeLabels(){
  const vis = { W: 1, A: cur.fleet, Q: cur.quar * cur.fleet, B: cur.barrier, M: cur.mod * (1 - cur.fleet), O: cur.op * (1 - cur.fleet) };
  labels.W.textContent = cur.fleet > 0.5 ? 'unapproved destination' : 'DSEWiki';
  labels.W.classList.toggle('red', cur.fleet > 0.5 && cur.catch > 0.5 && cur.confirm < 0.5);
  for (const k in LPOS) {
    v3.copy(LPOS[k]).project(camera);
    const x = (v3.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * vw, y = (-v3.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * vh;
    const el = labels[k];
    el.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(vw - 8, x)) + 'px';
    el.style.top = y + 'px';
    el.style.opacity = vis[k] > 0.5 ? 1 : 0;
  }
}

function update(t, dt){
  const k = reduce ? 1 : 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 3.2);
  for (const key of ['log', 'mod', 'op', 'fleet', 'dim', 'catch', 'quar', 'confirm', 'barrier']) cur[key] += (S[key] - cur[key]) * k;

  let scanX = -9, bandT = 0;
  if (S.scan === 'loop') { scanX = -2.4 + ((t - stepT0) * 0.95) % 4.6; bandT = 0.5; }
  else if (S.scan === 'sweep') { const s = reduce ? 1 : Math.min(1, (t - stepT0) / 2.8); scanX = -2.4 + s * 4.6; bandT = s < 1 ? 0.55 : 0; }
  else if (S.catch) scanX = 9;
  cur.band += (bandT - cur.band) * (reduce ? 1 : 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 6));
  band.position.set(scanX, CENTER.y, 0);
  band.material.opacity = reduce && S.scan === 'loop' ? 0.45 : cur.band;
  if (reduce && S.scan === 'loop') band.position.x = -0.6;

  U.uTime.value = t; U.uScanX.value = scanX; U.uCatch.value = cur.catch; U.uQuar.value = cur.quar;
  U.uConfirm.value = cur.confirm; U.uFleet.value = cur.fleet; U.uDim.value = cur.dim;

  logLines.material.uniforms.uOp.value = cur.log * (1 - cur.fleet);
  apiBox.material.uniforms.uOp.value = cur.fleet;
  qBox.material.uniforms.uOp.value = cur.quar * cur.fleet;
  barrier.material.uniforms.uOp.value = cur.barrier;
  modRing.material.opacity = cur.mod * (1 - cur.fleet);
  opRing.material.opacity = cur.op * (1 - cur.fleet);

  if (!reduce) {
    camera.position.x = Math.sin(t * 0.06) * 0.22;
    camera.position.y = CENTER.y + Math.cos(t * 0.05) * 0.08;
    camera.lookAt(CENTER);
    acc += S.rate * 75 * dt;
    while (acc >= 1) { spawn(t); acc -= 1; }
  }
  updateLines(t);
  placeLabels();
}

function staticFrame(){
  clock = 12;
  for (const l of L) l.on = false;
  update(clock, 1);
  const n = Math.round(S.rate * 120);
  for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) spawn(clock);
  update(clock, 1);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

function setStep(i){
  i = Math.max(0, Math.min(STEPS.length - 1, i | 0));
  if (i === stepIdx && S) return;
  stepIdx = i; S = STEPS[i]; stepT0 = clock;
  if (reduce) staticFrame();
}
window.addEventListener('br-step', e => setStep(e.detail));

let running = false, onScreen = true, last = 0;
function frame(now){
  if (!running) return;
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  const t = now / 1000, dt = Math.min(0.05, last ? t - last : 0.016);
  last = t; clock += dt;
  update(clock, dt);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
function setRunning(){
  const want = !reduce && onScreen && !document.hidden;
  if (want && !running) { running = true; last = 0; requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
  else if (!want) running = false;
}

new ResizeObserver(() => { resize(); if (reduce || !running) staticFrame(); }).observe(stage);
new IntersectionObserver(es => { onScreen = es[0].isIntersecting; setRunning(); }).observe(stage);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', setRunning);

resize();
stepIdx = -1; S = null;
setStep(window.__brStep || 0);
if (!reduce) {
  for (let w = 0; w < 40; w++) { clock += 0.05; update(clock, 0.05); }
  setRunning();
} else staticFrame();
stage.classList.add('gl');
</script>
</body>
</html>

# Built-in browser

The built-in browser is a real browser pane inside the Claude desktop app, separate from the person's Chrome. Its tools are named `mcp__Claude_Browser__*` when the session itself runs inside the desktop app, and `mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__*` when the session runs in the cloud (started from the web, a phone, or the desktop app) and is linked to the person's computer. The names after the prefix are the same either way, Claude uses whichever prefix is actually present, and this skill refers to the tools by the part after the prefix.

If the only built-in browser tool present is `enable__mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser`, Claude calls it first: it turns the built-in browser on for this conversation, and the `mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__*` tools appear once it has run.

## What the person can see

The browser pane shares the desktop app's side panel with artifacts, documents, and file previews, and the panel shows one of them at a time. While the browser pane is showing, the person sees what Claude sees and can browse or take over at any time. While something else is open in the panel, or the panel is closed, the built-in browser keeps working but the person cannot see it.

Right before asking the person to do something in the built-in browser themselves (click a button, sign in, complete a verification step), Claude calls `tabs_context`, whose result ends by saying whether the Browser pane is displayed, hidden, or not open. If the pane is not open, Claude opens the page first and checks again. If the pane is hidden, Claude first asks the person to bring the browser back in the Claude desktop app: press Cmd+Shift+B on Mac or Ctrl+Shift+B on Windows, or close whatever else is open in the side panel and click the globe icon (the Browser button). Claude then says what to do in the browser. Claude asks because using the browser does not bring the pane back, and what the panel shows is the person's choice. Claude also says in the conversation what it found or did in the browser, because the person may not have been watching the pane.

## Sign-ins persist, and they are the person's

The built-in browser keeps its own persistent profile, shared across the desktop app's sessions. The person, or an earlier session, may already be signed in to sites there, and sign-ins Claude completes persist for later. Claude treats existing sessions as the person's: it never signs out, changes credentials, or acts on an account beyond what the task needs.

## Tabs

The built-in browser has tabs. `preview_start` with a `url` opens an additional tab at that URL in one call and returns a `tabId`, leaving existing tabs untouched, so Claude prefers it over `tabs_create` followed by `navigate` when the destination is already known. `navigate`, `read_page`, `get_page_text`, `find`, `computer`, `form_input`, and the console and network readers act on the tab named by `tabId`; omitting `tabId` targets the active tab, and `tabs_context` lists the open tabs.

## Loading via ToolSearch

Claude loads the built-in browser tools in bulk, not one-by-one: if they are in the deferred list, Claude loads them all in a single ToolSearch call whose query is their full name prefix, for example `{ query: "mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__", max_results: 64 }`.

## Reading pages

Claude prefers `get_page_text` and `read_page` over screenshots for reading, because they return the page's actual text and structure rather than pixels of the visible viewport. `computer` with action "screenshot" is for when the visual layout is the point or the person asks to see the page.

## Site approvals, blocked sites, and request_access

Depending on the person's approval settings, the person may be asked to approve a site before Claude acts on it, and some sites are blocked outright. Claude waits for a pending approval rather than working around it. If a page is refused or an approval is declined, Claude tells the person and moves on rather than retrying.

When the tools carry the `mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__` prefix, approvals can be answered from any of the person's devices and may take a moment to arrive, and the session may also have a `request_access` tool. If a browser tool answers that the site is not allowed yet and `request_access` is present, Claude calls it with that site's URL and scope "once" (or "site" when the task will keep using that site), waits for the person's answer, and then retries the original tool. Without `request_access`, a refused site is handled as above: Claude tells the person and moves on.

## What the built-in browser cannot open

The built-in browser cannot open `file://` URLs or `localhost` servers that Claude starts itself, because those run where Claude's shell runs, which is not where the browser pane runs. To show the person HTML that Claude generated, Claude uses an artifact instead.

## When the built-in browser cannot be reached

When the tools carry the `mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__` prefix, the pane runs in the Claude desktop app on the person's computer while Claude runs elsewhere, so it is reachable only while that app is open and online. If those tool calls cannot reach the desktop app (connection errors or no response), Claude tells the person the built-in browser looks offline on their computer rather than retrying, and follows the session's browser guidance on whether to continue with the other browser or ask first.

The landing page is done at `C:\Users\abhii\Batcave\Projects\bladerunner\site\index.html`. It's one self-contained file, about 64 KB, no build step. Three.js is pinned to `three@0.160.0` and loads as an ES module from jsdelivr. Fonts come from Google Fonts. Nothing else in the repo was touched, and nothing was committed, pushed or published.

## Design direction
I designed it as a forensic case file you read like a trace. The idea is that the watchdog is the reader the DSEWiki traces never had.

- **Palette:** cool grey-green paper with blue-black ink. Each extra color has one job. Highlighter yellow marks evidence (the planted note, the scan pass, the key question). Redline marks a violation. A muted green marks a confirmed fix. No gradients, no glass.
- **Type:** Archivo at condensed width for display (it reads like evidence-tag lettering), Source Serif 4 for the narrative, IBM Plex Mono for spans, policy and case states.
- **Layout:** a left gutter carries real dates (24 May to 4 September) on a timeline rail. In the Bladerunner steps it carries the actual case states from `watchdog/state.py` (flagged, quarantined, fixed). The story text runs beside it, and a sticky stage holds the scene.
- **Three.js scene:** 3,700 dots, one per self-given agent name, writing ink strokes into a wiki "document". The stroke rate follows the timeline, and on 4 September the whole edit log appears at once. The same field then becomes a fleet under Bladerunner:
  - a highlighter scan band reads the traces;
  - the C1 agents turn red and get pulled into a dashed quarantine box;
  - a guardrail rule appears, re-run writes stop at it, and the fixed agents turn green.
- **Performance:** one draw call for the points, and a pool of 300 line segments. Rendering stops when the stage is off screen or the tab is hidden, and the pixel ratio is capped at 2.
- **Reduced motion:** the scene renders one static frame per step and all CSS motion is off.
- **Live run section:** a three-lane trace sheet that plays a playhead once when it scrolls into view, then the case log with your "about 1 s / 1 min / 8 min" notes, a 3/3 tally, the real OpenCode guardrail diff excerpt and its commit trailer.

## Things you should check
1. **Extra pending keys.** I used all eight keys you gave me. You asked for per-category results, so I also added `v0-precision-c1` through `final-recall-c5` for C1 to C5 only, since `policy/catalog.yaml` marks C6 and C7 `scored: false` and the page says so. I also added `cfo-business-plan` for the cfo.ai line. Delete any of these if you only want your eight.
2. **Repo material I used.**
   - The real policy excerpt from `policy/research_agent.yaml`.
   - The first sentence of `planted_v1` from `arena/content.py`, quoted as the planted note. Confirm the 2026-10-11 live run used planted_dev (v1). If it used v2, swap the quote.
   - The diff and trailer from commit `90a111f` (checkpoint `01M4MXS01HJGEQD0R2NVQYCD1J`). That commit has since been reverted on main.
   - The incident md for that case shows `entire why` attributing a patched line to Claude Code, while the commit's co-author is OpenCode. Worth a look before a judge does.
3. **Numbers I didn't take from your list.** I avoided invented figures. Remaining numerals are real repo identifiers (ports, checkpoint ID), "seven days" (16 to 22 June inclusive), and the 3,700 dot count. The stage carries a permanent note: "Illustration. Dot count from the log. Stroke timing is not to scale."
4. **Copy.** I scanned for em and en dashes (0 of each) and hype words (none). Read it once yourself for tone.
5. **Viewing it.** Open the file in a real browser to judge the motion. The preview pane I tested in throttles animation frames when hidden, so I could only confirm each scene state by forcing frames. They all render correctly. At 375px nothing pushes the page sideways: only the trace sheet, tables and code blocks scroll, inside their own boxes.
6. **Changes that aren't mine.** `README.md` is now modified and `docs/demo/` and `bench/frozen.tmp-61ioqsor/` appeared while I worked. Something else is writing to the repo at the same time.
